;===== machine: H2C end =====
;====== date: 20260729 ======

M1003 S0
M73 P100 R0

G392 S0 ;turn off nozzle clog detect
M993 A0 B0 C0 ; nozzle cam detection not allowed.

M400 ; wait for buffer to clear
G92 E0 ; zero the extruder
M211 Z1
M640.2 R0

G90
G1 Z{max_layer_z + 0.4} F900 ; lower z a little
M1002 judge_flag timelapse_record_flag
M622 J1
    G150.3
    M400 ; wait all motion done
    M991 S0 P-1 ;end smooth timelapse at safe pos
    M400 S5 ;wait for last picture to be taken
M623  ;end of "timelapse_record_flag"

G90
G1 Z{max_layer_z + 10} F900 ; lower z a little

G90
M141 S0 ; turn off chamber heating
M140 S0 ; turn off bed
M106 S0 ; turn off fan
M106 P2 S0 ; turn off remote part cooling fan
M106 P3 S0 ; turn off chamber cooling fan
M106 P9 S0 ; turn off ext toodhead cooling fan

; pull back filament to AMS
M620 S65535
{if long_retraction_when_cut}
M620.11 P1 I[current_filament_id] B[current_hotend] E-{retraction_distance_when_cut} F{max((flush_volumetric_speeds[current_filament_id]/2.4053*60), 200)}
{else}
M620.11 P0 I[current_filament_id] B[current_hotend] E0
{endif}

M620.11 K1 I[current_filament_id] B[current_hotend] R{retraction_distance_when_ec} F{max((flush_volumetric_speeds[current_filament_id]/2.4053*60), 200)}

M620.11 P1 I[current_filament_id] B[current_hotend] E-14
T65535
G150.2

M620 S65279
T65279
G150.2
M621 S65279

G150.3

M104 S0 T0; turn off hotend
M104 S0 T1; turn off hotend

M400 ; wait all motion done
M17 S
M17 Z0.4 ; lower z motor current to reduce impact if there is something in the bottom
{if (100.0 - max_layer_z/2) > 0}
    {if (max_layer_z + 100.0 - max_layer_z/2) < 320}
        G1 Z{max_layer_z + 100.0 - max_layer_z/2} F600
        G1 Z{max_layer_z + 98.0 - max_layer_z/2}
    {else}
        G1 Z320 F600
        G1 Z320
    {endif}
{else}
    {if (max_layer_z + 4.0) < 320}
        G1 Z{max_layer_z + 4.0} F600
        G1 Z{max_layer_z + 2.0}
    {else}
        G1 Z320 F600
        G1 Z320
    {endif}
{endif}
M400 P100
M17 R ; restore z current

M220 S100  ; Reset feedrate magnitude
M201.2 K1.0 ; Reset acc magnitude
M73.2   R1.0 ;Reset left time magnitude
M1002 set_gcode_claim_speed_level : 0

M1015.4 S0 K0 ;disable air printing detect

M1002 judge_flag print_finish_air_filt_flag

M1002 gcode_claim_action : 66
M145 P1

M623

max_bridge_length.reason: Support in back-top's zip-tie cavities is impossible to remove (2026-10-09 Mark1 article). With a 50 mm bridge limit the native 2026-10-10 slice has no support in the tie windows and its article drew no tie-cavity report. drain-readiness/prints/2026-10-09-current-back-top-tree-mark1/physical-result.json; drain-readiness/prints/2026-10-10-current-back-top-bridge50-mark1/README.md. Back-top only.

raft_first_layer_expansion.reason: Compact explicit tree-root brims retain adhesion and keep the emitted Support D envelope inside the usable bed border.

resolution.reason: Resolve the enclosure toolpaths well below bead width without retaining the mesh tessellation in support polygons.

support_filament.reason: Single external black PET-GF spool on the fixed left nozzle for model, support and interface.

support_interface_filament.reason: Single external black PET-GF spool on the fixed left nozzle for model, support and interface.

support_object_xy_distance.reason: Separate removable exterior trees from the C14 passage and its adjacent surfaces.

support_on_build_plate_only.reason: Native trees root outside the shell; the meter uses authored removable branches beside the plumbing.

support_style.reason: Cavity supports must be branching trees that can be removed through their access openings.

support_type.reason: Support only the accessible rail bearings and dry exterior field; bridge the protected plumbing interiors.

tree_support_branch_angle.reason: Keep the exterior trees beside the rear wall and clear of the protected cord passage.

tree_support_branch_diameter.reason: The tree trunks retain a broad root section toward their contact tips.

tree_support_branch_diameter_angle.reason: Lower tree trunks retain their base diameter.

tree_support_branch_distance.reason: Space the tree tips beneath accessible surfaces while the interface layers spread their contact.

z_hop_types.reason: Use the saved lift height as a fixed vertical hop before travel.
